minecraft:written_book_content.title: UMBRA: Asset Debrief
minecraft:written_book_content.author: UMBRA // Internal
pages:
RE: Anomaly 7C-"Thorne"
STATUS: Re-contained. Frame integrity nominal.

Field agent performance exceeds projections. The asset was reassembled and re-sealed without organizational exposure. Commendable.

Note for the agent, off the record:

You did the right thing. He was not a man anymore. He was a hole shaped like one. The Frame is where holes like that belong.
We are extending you a permanent contract. There are other Frames. Other holes. Thorne was one fracture in something far larger, and that larger thing has a name we do not write down.

It noticed you, down there. It notices everyone who gets close. We'll be in touch about what comes next.

— keep this quiet —
DIRECTOR CHEN

[a second page is paperclipped behind the first, in different handwriting]

He said your name at the end. Before it sealed. I didn't tell Chen that part.

- E.V.
